milestones.title: Foundation — Open-source reference signer
milestones.description: Open-source the Davara reference signer under Apache 2.0. Publish hash on-chain. Core signer coordination, action contracts, and quorum logic.

milestones.title: Identity — davara.dash DPNS + masternode auth
milestones.description: davara.dash DPNS identity live. Masternode-collateral signed-message auth → Davara session. CrowdNode-compatible verification path.

milestones.title: Council — Bylaws + first 9 seats elected
milestones.description: Council bylaws ratified. First 9 seats elected via DAO vote. Conduct covenant signed by all Council members.

milestones.title: Compliance — EU AI Act + NIST + ISO mapping
milestones.description: Davara Constitution mapping for EU AI Act Art. 55, NIST AI RMF 2.0, ISO/IEC 42001. Published as PDF + on-chain hash.

milestones.title: Quorum Demo — Public 5-of-9 live action
milestones.description: Public 5-of-9 quorum (3 model vendors × 3 human reviewers + 3 Council seats) approving a real test action. Recorded, audited, published.

milestones.title: Handover — Constitution v1.0 ratified by DAO
milestones.description: Davara Constitution v1.0 ratified by DAO vote. Council assumes ongoing review duty. Final report + audit closes proposal.
